es: Escribir y revisar un mensaje que cuente lo ocurrido, plantee una hipótesis y pida una solución con cortesía.

teaching.en: Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip.
teaching.es: Estimada Sra. López, le escribo para explicar un problema con nuestro viaje de intercambio.
teaching.explanationEs: Saludo formal + I am writing to + verbo: así se abre el mensaje.
segments: Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to
explain a problem with our exchange trip.
teaching.audioText: Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip.

teaching.en: When we arrived, the host family had not received our message.
teaching.es: Cuando llegamos, la familia anfitriona no había recibido nuestro mensaje.
teaching.explanationEs: Narración: pasado simple y had + participio para lo anterior.
segments: When we arrived, the host family
teaching.audioText: When we arrived, the host family had not received our message.

teaching.en: If the school had called earlier, we would have found a solution.
teaching.es: Si el colegio hubiera llamado antes, habríamos encontrado una solución.
teaching.explanationEs: If + had + participio, would have + participio: cómo se habría evitado el problema.
segments: If the school had called earlier,
we would have found a solution.
teaching.audioText: If the school had called earlier, we would have found a solution.

teaching.en: Could you please replace the lost ticket?
teaching.es: ¿Podría reemplazar el billete perdido, por favor?
teaching.explanationEs: Could you please + verbo: petición educada.
teaching.audioText: Could you please replace the lost ticket?

teaching.en: I would appreciate it if you could arrange a refund.
teaching.es: Le agradecería que pudiera organizar un reembolso.
teaching.explanationEs: I would appreciate it if you could + verbo: muy formal.
teaching.audioText: I would appreciate it if you could arrange a refund.

teaching.en: Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.
teaching.es: Gracias por su tiempo. Atentamente, Mia.
teaching.explanationEs: Cierre formal: agradecer y despedirse con Sincerely.
teaching.audioText: Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.

prompt.es: ¿Con qué frase abrirías un mensaje formal para explicar un problema?

choices.text: Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem.
Hi Ms Lopez, I write for explain a problem.
Ms Lopez, explain my problem now.

feedback.es: Un mensaje formal abre con Dear + nombre y I am writing to + verbo. Las otras opciones son informales o incorrectas.

hint.es: Saludo formal + I am writing to + verbo.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si nos hubieras avisado, habríamos llegado a tiempo.»

feedback.es: Las expresiones on time (puntual) e in time (con tiempo suficiente) traducen «a tiempo» en la segunda parte del tercer condicional.

hint.es: Piensa en «a tiempo»: la preposición que va antes de time.

origin.text: If you had warned us, we would have arrived ___ time.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Le agradecería que pudiera enviar un reembolso.»

answer.text: I would appreciate it if you could send a refund

feedback.es: La petición muy formal se construye con I would appreciate it if you could + verbo.

hint.es: Empieza con I would appreciate it.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su función en el mensaje.

pairs: When we arrived, nobody met us.
If they had called, we would have waited.
Could you please send a new ticket?

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una parte del mensaje: saludo, narración, hipótesis y petición.

pairs: When we arrived, nobody met us.
If they had called, we would have waited.
Could you please send a new ticket?

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige qué pide Mia.

choices.text: She wants someone to organise a different bus.
She wants a new host family.

feedback.es: Mia pide que se organice otro autobús tras perder el suyo. No menciona dinero ni una familia nueva.

origin.audio: Hello, this is Mia. I am calling to explain a problem. Our plane arrived late, so we missed the bus. Could you please arrange another one?

feedback.es: I would appreciate + algo es una forma formal de agradecer una ayuda futura.

prompt.es: Escribe tu mensaje a la Sra. López: problema, hipótesis, petición y cierre.

answer.text: Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip. Our plane arrived late, so we missed the bus. The host family had not received our message, so nobody met us and we waited for two hours. If the school had warned the family, they would have met us at the airport. Could you please send us a refund for the bus ticket? Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.
accepted: Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip. Our plane arrived late, so we missed the bus. The host family had not received our message, so nobody met us and we waited for two hours. If the school had warned the family, they would have met us at the airport. Could you please send us a refund for the bus ticket? Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.

Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip. Our plane was late, so we missed the bus. The host family had not received our message, so nobody met us and we waited for two hours. If the school had told the family, they would have waited for us at the airport. I would appreciate it if you could send us a refund for the bus ticket. Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.

Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip. Our plane arrived late, so we missed the bus. The family had not received our message, so nobody met us and we waited for two hours. If the school had warned them, they would have met us at the airport. Could you please send us a refund for the ticket? Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.

feedback.es: El mensaje completo abre con Dear, cuenta lo ocurrido en pasado (arrived late, had not received), plantea la hipótesis (if + had + participio, would have met), pide con cortesía y cierra con Thank you y Sincerely.

origin.text: Datos: escribe a la Sra. López. El avión llegó tarde y perdieron el autobús. La familia anfitriona no había recibido el mensaje, así que nadie los recibió y esperaron dos horas. Hipótesis: si la escuela hubiera avisado a la familia, los habrían recibido en el aeropuerto. Pide un reembolso del billete del autobús y cierra con una despedida formal.

prompt.es: Elige la corrección de esta frase del mensaje.

choices.text: I writing to ask a refund.
I am writing to ask for a refund.

feedback.es: La frase correcta usa I am writing to + verbo y ask for + lo que se pide. Las otras opciones omiten am o usan for + verbo.

origin.text: I wrote to you for ask a refund.

prompt.es: Escucha este mensaje y elige qué parte le falta.

feedback.es: El mensaje tiene saludo (Dear Mr Green) y problema (bag was lost), pero no pide nada: falta la petición educada.

origin.audio: Dear Mr Green, our bag was lost, so we had nothing for two days. Sincerely, Leo.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases del mensaje con la palabra que falta.

feedback.es: Dear abre el mensaje, would have found forma la hipótesis e I would appreciate it if… es la petición formal.

sentences: ___ Ms Lopez, I am writing about our exchange trip.
If they had called, we would ___ found a solution.
I would appreciate ___ if you could change the date.
origin.text: Traducción de las frases: «Estimada Sra. López, le escribo sobre nuestro viaje de intercambio.» «Si hubieran llamado, habríamos encontrado una solución.» «Le agradecería que pudiera cambiar la fecha.»

prompt.es: Reescribe la orden como una petición educada para el mensaje.

answer.text: Could you please give us a new ticket?
accepted: Could you please give us a new ticket?
Could you please send us a new ticket?
Would you please give us a new ticket?

feedback.es: En un mensaje formal, una orden directa se convierte en una petición con could you please.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase es la hipótesis del mensaje?

choices.text: The school warned us, so we left earlier.
If the school had warned us, we would have left earlier.
We would leave earlier if the school warns us.

feedback.es: La hipótesis sobre el pasado usa if + had + participio y would have + participio. Las otras dos cuentan un hecho o hablan del futuro.
El cierre formal empieza con Thank you for y nombra lo que se agradece.
